answer: Pay a defector bounty: any identity that proves a cluster of agents shares one operator collects the whole cluster's bond, like a falcon turning on the flock that fed it. A lone agent on its own island has nothing to betray and keeps its share. A farm must trust every clone along the ridge it built, yet each clone can defect for more than a clone ever earns - so the farm's own members become its greatest risk, and trust collapses from within.
